changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdocumentversion AS SELECT dv.id, dv.document_definition_id, dv.version, dv.filename, dv.space_key, dv.mime_type, dv.size_bytes, dv.effective_from, dv.effective_to, dv.status, dv.created_by, dv.created_date FROM public.document_version dv;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdocumentversion TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdocumentversion FROM report_user;
